[[Horseman Naramor]] | render = [[File:Large Scale.jpg|100px]] }} '''Mandragor Carapaces''' are the woody shells of the [[Mandragor]] that ambush travelers throughout [[Istan]]. They are hard to find due to the fact that the mandragor remain hidden until they attack, and then it's usually too late. The mandragor are a menace to travelers, so the Istani are always happy to see someone disposing of a large quantity of their carapaces. == Acquisition == * [[Nightfall]] ** [[Istan]] *** [[Mandragor Imp]] *** [[Mandragor Slither]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Mandragor Carapace#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== ====[[Plains of Jarin]]==== Leave [[Sunspear Great Hall]] and head west. The area around [[Tarom Rockbreaker]] contains many Mandragor pop-ups which drop Mandragor Carapaces and [[Lustrous Stones]]. == Collectors == {{:Timahr/Collector}} {{:Horseman Maxilus/Collector}} {{:Horseman Naramor/Collector}} [[Category:Items requested during Halloween]]
